policy: Keep classification best and existing loss unchanged
Only exact actual-best roots with at least two legal moves and nonlosing mover score get one equal-time excluded-actual search
Great candidate: actual cp >= 0 or winning mate; best other root cp <= -200 or losing mate; all scores exact
Missing, bounded, illegal, same-actual, better alternative, or losing actual scores never produce !!
Alternative complete legal PV stored and rebuilt on cache reuse; fabricated annotation ignored
Contradictory same-root cached best and played copies are rejected
Badge tied to actual UCI destination, ply, and full FEN after move; pending has null badge
budget: At most two searches per row, unchanged upper estimate; qualifying best rows previously used one search and now use two
cache: Schema 1 cache remains untouched; schema 2 computes fresh proof and uses a separate hashed key. Original game archives unchanged.
limits: Provisional Regicide candidate within finite search, not objective brilliance or sacrifice proof
Controlled tests verify classification logic; one constructed real-engine position is not a playing-strength claim
